question: ¿Cuántos ensayos clínicos de cáncer de próstata incluyen un fármaco aprobado dirigido al receptor de andrógenos (gen AR)?

attempts.query:
WITH drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.parent_chembl_id
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary p ON p.chembl_id = md.parent_chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'AR' AND p.max_phase = 4
),
names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n FROM (
    SELECT lower(p.pref_name) AS n FROM drugs d JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary p ON p.chembl_id = d.parent_chembl_id
    UNION
    SELECT lower(s.synonyms) FROM drugs d
    JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = d.parent_chembl_id
    JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
  ) x WHERE length(n) >= 5
),
trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM aact.browse_conditions WHERE downcase_mesh_term = 'prostatic neoplasms'
),
tnames AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT tn.nct_id)
FROM tnames tn JOIN names nm ON position(nm.n IN tn.n) > 0
